rows.label: LAMP SHELL
rows.clue: Marine animal with bivalve shell having a pair of arms bearing tentacles for capturing food

rows.label: GRAY HEN
rows.clue: Female black grouse

rows.label: POTATO MOTH
rows.clue: Greyish-brown moth whose larva is the potato tuberworm

rows.label: DUSKY SHARK
rows.clue: Relatively slender blue-grey shark

rows.label: BLACK GROUSE
rows.clue: Grouse of which the male is bluish-black

rows.label: DIATOM
rows.clue: Microscopic unicellular marine or freshwater colonial alga having cell walls impregnated with silica

rows.label: SPLINT BONE
rows.clue: A rudimentary metacarpal or metatarsal bone on either side of the cannon bone in the leg of a horse or related animal

rows.label: PLOVER
rows.clue: Any of numerous chiefly shorebirds of relatively compact build having straight bills and large pointed wings

rows.label: BARK BEETLE
rows.clue: Small beetle that bores tunnels in the bark and wood of trees

rows.label: WHITE WOLF
rows.clue: Wolf of Arctic North America having white fur and a black-tipped tail

rows.label: FLOUR BEETLE
rows.clue: An insect that infests flour and stored grains

rows.label: BURRO
rows.clue: Small donkey used as a pack animal

rows.label: EQUINE
rows.clue: Hoofed mammals having slender legs and a flat coat with a narrow mane along the back of the neck

rows.label: EIDER
rows.clue: Duck of the northern hemisphere much valued for the fine soft down of the females

rows.label: DEER
rows.clue: Distinguished from Bovidae by the male's having solid deciduous antlers

rows.label: GAME FOWL
rows.clue: Any of several breeds reared for cockfighting

rows.label: GLASS SNAKE
rows.clue: Snakelike lizard of Europe and Asia and North America with vestigial hind limbs and the ability to regenerate its long fragile tail

rows.label: SEA RAVEN
rows.clue: Large sculpin of western Atlantic

rows.label: BOBOLINK
rows.clue: Migratory American songbird

rows.label: AARDVARK
rows.clue: Nocturnal burrowing mammal of the grasslands of Africa that feeds on termites

rows.label: COMMON LOUSE
rows.clue: Head or body louse

rows.label: STICKLEBACK
rows.clue: Small (2-4 inches) pugnacious mostly scaleless spiny-backed fishes of northern fresh and littoral waters having elaborate courtship

rows.label: GOLDFINCH
rows.clue: American finch whose male has yellow body plumage in summer

rows.label: BROWN SNAIL
rows.clue: Serious garden pest having a brown shell with paler zigzag markings

rows.label: SQUIRREL
rows.clue: A kind of arboreal rodent having a long bushy tail

rows.label: HANGING FLY
rows.clue: Any of various mecopterous insects of the family Bittacidae
